reviewer: Assistant, single visual pass, not an independent palaeographer
scope: Viewed 61 original/repaired row pairs in nine contact-sheet segments. This checks visible residuals, not the correctness of every Boxer unit.
observations: Neighbouring-line material is generally reduced, but some touching/nearby strokes remain ambiguous.
Plant or paint material remains in some row domains, for example f3r paragraph 2 and f4r paragraph 2.
